Projects / Detail card

App overview

Gaming + streaming / Windows

PixelBridge

Unpublished draft

PixelBridge brings cloud-service launch links, local emulation, and your own media into a native Windows launchpad. It is not an independent cloud rendering service: local content runs on your PC. Use direct HDMI to a TV, or Sunshine and Moonlight for LAN streaming with planned onboarding and diagnostics. No router WAN port forwarding or UPnP is required for the LAN setup.

No input or HDMI paywall: all usable Xbox controller mappings, standard importable profiles, and direct-HDMI TV setup are included in every tier. HDMI guidance uses supported Windows display/audio settings, not Sunshine encoding or TV firmware control. Cloud-service latency still applies. Supporter adds ad-free library conveniences; Pro adds advanced editable and saved profile variants and their import/export.

You supply your accounts, subscriptions, emulators, and legally sourced content. No games, ROMs, BIOS files, or keys are bundled. Final release requirements and production downloads are not yet listed.
